name: Motorcycle Simulator North Dakota
summary:
Ride with your friends, from the seat - all the way round Fargo, North Dakota.

RIDE ONLINE TOGETHER
Up to four riders in a room. Quick Ride joins an open room; Private Room gives your friends a 4-digit code. See each other's bikes and riders leaning into the bends, with names and speeds, and hear each other's engines. Ride To puts you right behind any rider. Optional voice chat.

YOUR RIDER, YOUR COLOURS
Twelve riders and eight bike colours - your helmet matches your bike.
